lee_support: Alert: multiple customers failing initial embeddings after token exchange - 401/403 across Bluecrest, Nimbly, Asteris. Marking P1 because onboarding flows are blocked (trial & paid). Logs attached.

lee_support: ```
POST /v1/session/exchange -> 401
response: { "error": "invalid_token", "reason": "stale_cache" }
user_agent: integration-runner/2.3.1
clients: acct_bluecrest, acct_nimbly, acct_asteris
```

jamie_csm: Thanks. Quick ask: who owns outreach for each account? Renewal dates? Need to triage churn risk first.

rene_cs: I own Bluecrest (renewal 45d). Nimbly is trial w/ heavy embed usage, renewal unknown, high risk. Asteris is a multi-team enterprise (renewal 7 months), I'll handle enterprise comms.

parth_se: Preliminary root cause: edge cache served expired verification tokens after a recent cache invalidation. Short-term mitigation: have customers rotate the integration token and restart their ingest workers. I'll prepare a CLI one-liner.

parth_se: Playbook snippet to share:```
# rotate key and restart ingest worker
redwoodctl keys rotate --account <acct_id> --key-id <key>
systemctl restart embed-worker.service
# wait 90s for global cache flush
```

jamie_csm: I'll send a concise comms pack to customers: 1) impact statement 2) steps to rotate token 3) offer 30m pairing session 4) status page link. Draft below — feedback?

jamie_csm: "We've detected token validation failures during your embedding setup that prevent content ingestion. As a temporary fix, please rotate your API token and restart your ingest process using the steps below. If you'd like, we can join a 30-minute session to walk through the rotation. We're treating this as a priority and will keep you updated."

parth_se: Suggest adding: "If rotation is not possible, reply and we'll perform a guided rotation with a temporary session token."

lee_support: Created ticket CS-4599 and flagged escalation=true, churn_risk=high for Nimbly, medium for Bluecrest, low for Asteris. SLA: contact within 45 minutes.

ops-bot: Ticket CS-4599 created by lee_support. Priority: P1. SLA: 45m initial outreach. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4599

rene_cs: I'll message Asteris now, but hold off on credits. For Nimbly, propose proactive success check + trial extension if unresolved after 24h.

jamie_csm: Sending outreach to Bluecrest and Nimbly now. Tagging @parth_se for pairing on Nimbly. Included rotation commands and ETA for next update. :email:

parth_se: I'll be available for a live session in 20m. Also flagging infra to perform a cache flush if customers still see 401 after rotation.

lee_support: Noted. After customer responses, please post a 1-line status in this thread: customer, action taken, outcome. If any customer asks for data/legal review, escalate to policy.

jamie_csm: Update (10m): Bluecrest rotated keys and resumed ingest. Nimbly requested guided rotation and scheduled a call at 13:30 PT. Asteris acknowledged and waiting on internal change window (EOD).

parth_se: Confirmed Bluecrest success — ingest resumed and embeddings index building. Closing interim alert for Bluecrest.

lee_support: Thanks team. Keeping ticket open for Nimbly/Asteris until confirmed. Will update SLA tracking. :thumbsup:
